eventMetadata.context_description: Recent short-term forecasts from agencies including the Met Office and BBC Weather indicate a high near 32°C for Panama City on August 19 amid typical wet-season thundery showers and persistent cloud cover. These conditions, driven by the Intertropical Convergence Zone, increase humidity and afternoon convection that limit peak daytime heating, keeping values close to the August climatological average of 30–32°C while rarely allowing excursions above 33–34°C. Model consensus and current observations of widespread moisture support the market's heaviest weighting toward 31–33°C outcomes, with lower probabilities for extremes reflecting both historical rarity and expected diurnal moderation from rainfall. Updated model runs and local observations over the next 24 hours will refine resolution thresholds.
